in_marathi.name: Ambresh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ambresh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ambresh is a name derived from the Sanskrit language. It is a compound of two roots: ‘Amba’ meaning immortal or invincible and ‘Resh’ meaning ruler or king. This name is often given to boys in Hindu culture, signifying a strong, enduring, and powerful individual.
